style_en: Vertical 9:16 miniature diorama 3D CG render in an empty white space. Smooth faceless figurines (no eyes, nose or mouth details), told apart by clothing and hairstyle. Soft shadows, slightly high angle. Mostly white and gray, only key objects red. Keep the top 35% of the frame empty with no heads or objects; place the main subject between 35% and 68% of the height, centered. The worker is always the same man figurine in a plain gray work jumpsuit with no logo and short black hair. Present day; no extra props from other eras, no year plaque, no caption plate.
avoid_en: logos, brand names, readable text or numbers, realistic human eyes, eyeball close-ups, blood, wounds, fire, faces resembling real people

worker.desc_en: the worker, a man figurine with a smooth featureless face, short black hair, plain gray work jumpsuit with no logo, gray gloves
